title: Bose Polarons as Relativistic Unruh-DeWitt Detectors: Entanglement Harvesting from Bose-Einstein Condensates
summary: An impurity in a Bose-Einstein condensate with time-tunable coupling realizes an Unruh-DeWitt detector of the condensate’s effective relativistic phonon field.

summary: The COHERENT Collaboration reports the most precise measurement of the coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering cross section to date. title: Cluster-Decorated Lieb Lattice: A Convenient and Reliable Platform for Tuning Flat-Band Energy
summary: Flat bands harbor exotic electron physics. A new way of realizing them could make the physics more accessible.

summary: We investigate the quantum phases of higher-spin Kitaev models using tensor network methods. Our results reveal distinct valence-bond-ordered phases for spin-1, spin-$\frac{3}{2}$, and spin-2 models. summary: We present a tangent-space Krylov method for efficient computation of zero-temperature real-frequency spectral functions on top of ground-state matrix product states obtained from the density matrix renormalization group. summary: Within a model where micrometer-size soft colloidal particles are viewed as liquid drops, we theoretically study the contact interaction between them. title: Far-from-Equilibrium Thermodynamics of Non-Abelian Thermal States
summary: Noncommutativity of observables is a defining feature of quantum physics. summary: We generate multipartite entangled states of two, three, and four matter qubits, where the entanglement is distributed over macroscopic distances via a photonic network link. Trapped-ion $^{88}{\mathrm{Sr}}^{+}$ qubits are entangled directly via an optical fibre link, and the entanglement is subsequ…

title: Evidence of Galaxy Cluster Rotation and Intrahalo Gas Motions in the Cosmic Microwave Background
summary: Thomson scattering of cosmic microwave background photons off rotating intracluster gas reveals a secondary anisotropy associated with the rotational kinematic Sunyaev–Zel’dovich effect.

summary: The Landau paradigm has been a powerful framework for understanding phase transitions involving spontaneous symmetry breaking. title: Photon-Statistics Time Delay in Quantum Attosecond Photoelectron Interferometry
summary: Photoelectron interference can reveal otherwise hidden properties of quantum light through an apparent attosecond time shift.

title: High-Performance Quantum Frequency Conversion from Ultraviolet to Telecom Band
summary: Quantum frequency conversion (QFC) is essential for bridging the spectral gap between stationary qubits and low-loss optical communication channels. title: Magnon Kerr Effect in a Magnetic Thin Film Strongly Coupled to a Microwave Resonator
summary: Progress in cavity magnonics relies on tunable nonlinearities in magnon-photon interactions for controlling magnon dynamics and frequency conversion. title: Tripartite Haar Random State Has No Bipartite Entanglement
summary: Researchers demonstrate that bipartite Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen entanglement cannot be distilled from tripartite Haar random states by local operations.

title: Mixed-State Phases from Local Reversibility
summary: Researchers establish a framework using local reversibility to correctly classify phases of matter in open and noisy quantum systems.

title: Enduring Mechanical Memory from the Constitutive Response of Elastically Recoverable Nanostructured Materials
summary: Vertically aligned carbon nanotube foams exhibit return point memory, opening new opportunities for mechanical computing applications.

title: Geometrically Frustrated Quadrupoles on the Pyrochlore Lattice and Generalized Spin Liquids
summary: A semiclassical framework models quantum quadrupoles as biaxial tensors, showing how angular-momentum-dependent geometries dictate generalized nematic phases and quadrupolar spin liquids in frustrated magnets.

title: Emergent Altermagnetism at Surfaces of Antiferromagnets: Full Symmetry Classification and Material Identification
summary: A theoretical surface spin-group framework demonstrates that surface symmetry breaking in conventional antiferromagnets naturally induces two-dimensional altermagnetism across more than 150 candidate materials.

title: Quantum Birthmarks: Ergodicity Breaking Beyond Scarring
summary: Researchers develop a theoretical framework showing that quantum systems permanently retain a memory of their initial state and early dynamics, in defiance of classical expectations.

title: Effective Ionic Valence and Local Magnetic Moment in Kagome Superconductors
summary: Revealing concealed ionic local moments in kagome superconductors reflects strong local correlations.

title: Ultrastrong Unconventional Spin Current via Noncollinear Spin-Orbit Filtering
summary: An asymmetric platinum interface enables noncollinear spin-orbit filtering, breaking bulk symmetry constraints to generate out-of-plane spin currents for field-free magnetization switching.

title: Experimentally Accessible Measurement of Irreversibility in Stochastic Systems by Categorizing Single-Molecule Displacements
summary: A model-free method that infers irreversibility directly from single-molecule position recordings offers a versatile and accessible tool to characterize the nonequilibrium behavior of small, time-dependent, continuous systems.

title: Standard Model of Electromagnetism and Chirality in Crystals
summary: A comprehensive symmetry-based classification identifies 12 fundamentally distinct types of crystal structures across five polar and five chiral categories, providing a complete taxonomy to predict and engineer next-generation multifunctional materials.

title: Coulomb Screening of Superconductivity in Magic-Angle Graphene
summary: Metallic layers placed near magic-angle graphene suppress Coulomb interactions and reveal that its superconductivity is driven by electronic interactions rather than conventional atomic vibrations.

title: Fast Algorithm for 2D Rigidity Percolation
summary: An algorithm for simulating the rigidity percolation transition, based on novel theoretical results, overcomes previous size limitations and enables the highly precise characterization of its universality classes, shedding new light on rigidity transitions in amorphous systems.

title: Three-Dimensional Electronic Structures in Superconducting Ruddlesden-Popper Bilayer Nickelate Films
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy of superconducting bilayer nickelate thin films reveals an intrinsic three-dimensional electronic structure and a strong-coupling pairing regime on the orbital band.

title: Interaction-Driven Topological Transitions in Monolayer ${\mathrm{TaIrTe}}_{4}$
summary: Theoretical and experimental mapping of monolayer TaIrTe reveals a rich landscape of interaction-driven topological phases on a single naturally layered crystal—no moiré engineering required.

title: Floquet-Based Ising Machines Escape Local Minima in QUBO Problems
summary: The analog Floquet solver incorporates Floquet amplitude modulations to help it escape local minima, significantly improving the accuracy of parametric oscillator-based Ising machines in solving optimization problems.

title: Candidate for a Fractional Topological Insulator in Twisted ${\mathrm{MoTe}}_{2}$
summary: Pump-probe modulation spectroscopy of a MoTe bilayer superlattice reveals an out-of-plane antiferromagnetic response, providing experimental signatures of a putative fractional topological insulator state.

title: Vast World of Quantum Advantage
summary: Researchers explore quantum advantage across different domains, showing a picture much richer and more nuanced than commonly appreciated.
